svg.text: Green light changes how active the enzyme is, not how much there is
The same cultures read two ways — our ELISA on top, our DNPH assay below
Here it moves. At 13 h green is
14× red — and by 16 h it inverts.
Our wiki says it plainly: the switch has not
been demonstrated to work. Say that out loud.
Single plates, technical replicates within a plate, no statistical test. Do not quote a green-vs-red number from the short-term run —
our Results and Measurement pages disagree on which colour leads at 3 and 8 hours.
